index.title: Input number
index.description: Position of the input in the run: urls first, then files, counting from 1.

input.title: Input
input.description: The link converted, or file:<fileName> for an inline file.

status.title: Status
status.description: converted: the Parquet is ready (and charged). failed: see error, not charged. skipped: the run's maximum charge was reached before this input, not charged.

parquetKey.title: Key-value store key
parquetKey.description: Key of the Parquet file in the run's default key-value store.

parquetUrl.title: Parquet download link
parquetUrl.description: Direct link to the Parquet file; works without an Apify account for as long as the run's storage is kept.

columns.title: Columns
columns.description: Each output column's name and Arrow type, in order.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: What the conversion assumed or could not read (e.g. an ambiguous date order).

report.title: Conversion report
report.description: The full report: per-column types, null and rejected counts with examples, encoding, delimiter, sheets, warnings and token estimates.

sql.title: SQL
sql.description: The query run over this file, when one was given.

query.title: Query result
query.description: columns, types, rows (a list of row arrays), row_count and truncated (true when more rows matched than queryLimit).

queryError.title: Query error
queryError.description: Why the query gave no result (code, message, hint). The query was not charged.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the input was not converted: code (e.g. fetch_failed, unsupported_format, invalid_input, input_too_large, charge_limit_reached), message and hint (what to do next). Not charged.

example.hint: Pass options.format, or send one of the supported formats; you were not charged.

charged.title: Events charged
charged.description: The pay-per-event events charged for this input: file-converted, and query-run when the query ran.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per input: what happened and where the Parquet file is.

query.title: Query results
query.description: The SQL result of each converted file.
